Milestone 1: IMS design
Milestone Outputs: 
・Detailed IMS architecture designed specifically for Project Catalyst. This includes:
・A comprehensive solution deck, user stories, and the first functional prototypes reflecting the impact measurement capabilities.
・The prototypes will offer a clear representation of how the system will capture and analyze impact data.

Acceptance criteria:
・The functional prototype demonstrates the ability to capture, process, and analyze the necessary impact data. 
・The solution deck (slidedeck) is detailed, outlining the architecture, use cases, and technical approach, and is made publicly available on Sustainable ADA’s Google Drive.

Evidence of milestone completion:
・Solution deck available for public review. 
・Prototype demo showcasing basic functionalities and data handling, shared with stakeholders for review.

Please find evidence of milestone completion here:
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/153fFyAkZuF1nRBnD2Kh3_F544NWwG1Fa?usp=sharing

ms.report:
This milestone is complete and meets all acceptance criteria, with a functional demo, open-source code, video walkthrough, governance framework, and roadmap provided as public evidence.

Problem Statement
This milestone required us to demonstrate a functional IMS prototype, publish open-source code, and provide accessible evidence of usability, governance planning, and strategic roadmap.

Activities Completed
・Developed and deployed the IMS demo site showing the full workflow: create → measure → evidence → share.
・Published the IMS source code on GitHub under MIT license with modular architecture and contributor-ready documentation.
・Recorded and published a demo video walkthrough to make functionality easy to verify.
・Produced supporting documents: Governance Framework (v1.0) and a Scalability & Business Roadmap (Q3 2025–Q4 2026).
・Compiled all artifacts into a transparent evidence folder.

Deliverables & Evidence
This submission meets the acceptance criteria by delivering:
・Functional Demo Website: ims.impactweb3.com → Demonstrates live system functionality.
・Open-Source Codebase: github.com/impactweb3/ims → Public repo with modular code, MIT license, contributor docs.
・Video Walkthrough: YouTube Demo → Accessible ~1-2min demonstration of IMS in use.
・Governance Framework (v1.0): Document Link → Defines ethical governance, decision-making, and oversight structures.
・Scalability & Business Roadmap (Q3 2025–Q4 2026): Document Link → Provides clear trajectory for growth, partnerships, and maturity.
・Evidence Folder: Google Drive → Contains supporting materials.

Impact
This milestone delivers a functional, open-source IMS that Catalyst reviewers can independently verify. It establishes technical validity, transparency, and usability through a live demo, repo, and video proof. Additional governance and roadmap documents show strategic foresight and position IMS for sustainable deployment.
By achieving this milestone, IMS moves from concept to MVP-ready infrastructure,
